study type: Comparative observational study (ex vivo) with in vitro experimental validation
exposure: Umbilical cord serum from post-kidney-transplant pregnancies
cohort: The study participants were offspring of women with uncomplicated pregnancies and offspring of women after kidney transplantation, whose umbilical cord blood was used to isolate ECFCs.
finding: ECFCs from offspring of mothers with kidney transplants showed significantly less proliferation, migration, and angiogenesis compared to controls, and umbilical cord serum from post-kidney-transplant pregnancies caused similar functional aberrations in ECFCs from uncomplicated pregnancies.
cross-section timing: Samples (umbilical cord blood) were collected at birth.
